events-02.title: Characterization tests before any behavior change
events-02.risk: The Postgres file must match the *postgres*_test.go discovery in tools/run-postgres-roundtrip-tests.mjs:126-135 and uses UBAG_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN. CI runs it (ci.yml:166-196).
events-02.test_approach: Pin the current behavior across memory, sqlite and postgres stores. WaitEvents: returns on a new event; (nil,false) for a missing job; (nil,true,ctx.Err()) on cancel; honors limit and ordering; a duplicate worker event adds no event. StreamJobEvents: closes on terminal. SSE: replays from 0, never closes on terminal, ping on idle. Consumer: no events, malformed JSONL, zero or two terminals, and a truncated stream must all become failed, never completed.

events-03.title: Per-job wake hub for all three stores, with a bounded fallback poll
events-03.flag: UBAG_EVENT_NOTIFY=off|local|postgres (default off; fallback stays 50ms). UBAG_EVENT_FALLBACK_MS defaults to 2000 when on.
events-03.risk: Lost wake-up unless the waiter subscribes before the first read. Use a cap-1 non-blocking channel per waiter and unregister via defer. Notify only after a successful commit at the event-writing sites (sqlite.go:142,202,408,512; postgres.go:124,194,395,501). Waiters must be registered only after auth, because the hub carries job ids and no data.
events-03.test_approach: Unit tests with fake stores plus -race: subscribe, read, wait, then notify wakes within about 10ms; a dropped notify is recovered by the fallback; 1k waiters across 100 jobs wake only the matching ones; cancel leaks no goroutines. Then re-run the events-02 suite with the flag on.

events-04.title: Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY for multi-replica deployments
events-04.flag: UBAG_EVENT_NOTIFY=postgres. Optional UBAG_EVENT_NOTIFY_DSN for a direct, non-pooled connection.
events-04.risk: Fold pg_notify('ubag_job_events', job_id) into the insert statement via a CTE in insertEvent (postgres.go:645-656) so it adds no round trip. Use a dedicated pgx.Connect listener outside the 20-connection pool, with reconnect backoff and NotifyAll after reconnect. LISTEN is incompatible with transaction-mode pgbouncer. NOTIFY serializes at commit, so cap the token event rate. A stalled listener grows the server's notify queue, so dispatch must be non-blocking. The shared platform Postgres has an unknown connection budget.
events-04.test_approach: Postgres test: two stores on one database, so the write on store A wakes a waiter on store B in under 100ms. Kill the listener with pg_terminate_backend and check that waiters recover via the fallback and a resync. Check that a rolled-back tx sends no notify, and that a duplicate worker event sends none.

events-05.test_approach: The events-02 contract tests. Count queries with a sql driver wrapper: a hit costs 1 query and an idle miss costs 2.

Add ubag_event_wakeups_total{source=local|notify|fallback} and an event-to-frame lag histogram.
events-06.test_approach: httptest streaming test (not only snapshot=true): events arrive without polling delay; resume skips already-seen events; a terminal event closes the stream; Last-Event-ID past terminal gives 204; a stalled reader is dropped after the deadline; the cap returns 503.

events-07.title: gRPC stream and facade/cancel waiters on the hub
events-07.risk: The facade must keep the 'store error != client disconnect' rule (PROGRESS.md:1191). The cancel-watch must still catch a cancel that lands between wakes, so keep a 2s fallback Get.
events-07.test_approach: Extend the events-02 gRPC test: drop the extra Get by using isTerminalEvent, and add an idle-stream TTL or heartbeat. Facade tests (done, timeout, abort, error) stay green. Cancel test: the worker context is cancelled within about 100ms of a cancel.

events-08.title: Incremental worker-event streaming with provisional tokens (plan item 3)
contract_first: optional StreamingWorkerRunner next to WorkerRunner (workerconsumer.go:151)
Store.ApplyWorkerEvents batch (store.go:159)
events-08.flag: UBAG_WORKER_STREAM_EVENTS (default off). Engine streaming is a separate Python flag.
events-08.risk: The runner needs StdoutPipe plus a line reader to replace command.Run, and the daemon must emit per line. Apply non-terminal events live, and hold the single terminal event until the daemon JOB_END status is 'completed' (or the process exits 0). Anything else goes through applyFailure, never success. The pre-apply gate at workerconsumer.go:450 disappears, so the 'false truncation' guarantee must be re-proved. Coalesce token deltas before the cap: maxWorkerEvents=512 (workerconsumer.go:99), and each ApplyWorkerEvent is one transaction with a FOR UPDATE, so batch with one notify per batch. The engine's whole-interaction retry (engine.py:464-472) can re-emit tokens, and workerEventKey dedupe would drop them, so tokens must carry an attempt marker or streaming must begin after the last retry point. Ingestion metrics change meaning (observeIngestion events and duration). Lease renewal must cover long ingestion.
events-08.test_approach: Fake runner emits live non-terminal events, and the test asserts the store sees them before RunWorker returns. Kill the daemon mid-stream: the job ends failed, with no completed. Duplicate and out-of-order events. Cancel mid-stream. Python test in apps/worker/tests with an injected driver that fails once mid-stream. Keep the existing TestDaemonJob* tests green.

rust-05.test_approach: Offline self-test with the Python relay as both A and B must report 0% delta and pass the byte-compare. Real runs happen on a dedicated lab helper and the report is attached to PROGRESS.md.

rust-06.title: Python-baseline fixes before any Rust verdict: reuse buffers, recv_into, single-join framing, pipe size cap, cheaper health loop
rust-06.flag: Behavior-preserving fixes need none. The F_SETPIPE_SZ cap uses UBAG_VOICE_PIPE_BYTES (unset by default). A null-sink rate=48000 channels=1 change needs UBAG_VOICE_SINK_SPEC_PIN=1 and a live check first.
rust-06.risk: Pipe cap and sink spec change latency and Chrome behavior, so verify live. Buffer reuse must stay thread-safe under the per-codec lock.
rust-06.test_approach: Existing pytest stays green; add tests that output bytes are unchanged for the corpus; compare before/after with the rust-05 harness.

rust-07.title: CONDITIONAL: Rust relay crate, env-selectable and rollbackable
contract_first: rust-02 fixtures
protocol-v2 doc
rust-07.flag: UBAG_VOICE_RELAY_IMPL=python|rust, default python; fall back to python if the binary is missing
rust-07.risk: Only start if the gate says go. Vendored libopus can change encoder bytes; musl vs glibc; extra CI and toolchain cost; third runtime to maintain.
rust-07.test_approach: cargo test against the shared vectors; the same black-box suite and A/B harness run against both implementations; rollback drill flips the env and confirms the next call uses python with the gateway unchanged.

rust-08.title: Gate verdict and rollback drill record
rust-08.risk: A verdict from an unrepresentative host.
rust-08.test_approach: Attach the report JSON with libopus version, host class and CI lower bounds; state go/stop against the pre-registered rule.

security-01.title: Contracts: helper proto, authz actions, audit vocabulary, error codes
contract_first: helper.proto (Register, ReportCapacity, RunAttempt stream, Renew/Cancel/Inspect, OpenViewer, voice control) with attempt_id, node_id, lease_generation, input_fingerprint, workload_version in every message
fleet:read, fleet:manage, browser:interact actions in rbac.ts and authz.go
audit event names plus actor type node
UBAG-HELPER-* error codes
OpenAPI: viewer ticket and fleet read endpoints
security-01.test_approach: pnpm test:security and check:contracts for role/action parity; buf lint and breaking; authz_test asserts viewer, developer and service lack fleet:* and browser:interact.
security-01.risk: Parity gate fails if rbac.ts and authz.go diverge.

security-02.title: Pre-helper isolation fixes: tenant-keyed topology upsert, remote_endpoint redaction, tab context check, namespaced profile policy
security-02.test_approach: Go tests: tenant B reporting tenant A's instance_id or context_id leaves A's row intact and drops B's tab; instanceToResponse omits remote_endpoint. Worker pytest: namespaced policy ignores user_data_dir and profile_dir options.
security-02.risk: Redacting remote_endpoint may break the dashboard browser page; check the types.ts consumer first.

security-03.title: Helper trust plane: separate mTLS listener, URI-SAN node identity, node registry with pinned SPKI and per-RPC state check
security-03.flag: UBAG_HELPER_PLANE=off by default; no listener when off; UBAG_HELPER_GRPC_ADDR, UBAG_HELPER_CA_FILE
security-03.test_approach: Go tests with generated certs: no cert, wrong CA, unknown SPKI, revoked, expired, CN spoof and message node_id mismatch are each rejected; revoking mid-stream ends the stream within one message; reflection absent; the old grpcServer never serves helper RPCs; sqlite migration-vs-bootstrap parity test.
security-03.risk: Migration numbers 0019/0020 are taken on the voice branch; start at 0021 and re-check at merge.

security-04.title: Attempt capability tokens (RS256, separate key) and App-JWT audience guard
security-04.test_approach: Unit: an attempt token is rejected by resolveAppJWT, and an app JWT is rejected by the helper verifier. Expired, wrong node, wrong generation, wrong key set, and exp beyond the lease are rejected. Renewal keeps claims identical except exp.

security-05.title: HelperAttemptSpec projection and egress allowlist (no callbacks, client, local paths, profile options)
security-05.test_approach: Golden test: a spec built from a job with callbacks, client, context, attachment_local_paths and user_data_dir contains none of them. Property test: no key in the spec matches the payloadpolicy denylist. Env test: the helper env equals the allowlist minus the remote-browser and noVNC vars.
security-05.risk: The shared allowlist refactor must not change local worker env behavior.

security-06.title: Helper-to-primary ingest validation: node, attempt and generation fencing, event-type allowlist, caps, node-namespaced projection
security-06.test_approach: Go tests: a stale-generation commit is rejected and audited with no job mutation; cross-tenant job_id is rejected; oversize output fails the attempt; a duplicate commit is idempotent; secret-bearing event data is redacted by the store sanitizer.
security-06.risk: Overlaps the execution-contract area, which owns the attempt table; agree on the schema first.

security-07.title: Scoped asset staging: manifest-bound get and put, sha256 and size verify, indistinguishable 404
security-07.test_approach: Go tests: key outside DeclaredAttachments, another job's key, a put on a get-only token, and an expired lease all return the same 404/403 shape; streamed bytes are verified against the sha256 and the size cap; helper uploads of undeclared artifact kinds are rejected.
security-07.risk: ArtifactStore has no tenant parameter, so the check must be in the handler.

security-08.title: Profile and conversation affinity: tenant-owned profile_ref registry; node_id and profile_ref on conversations
security-08.test_approach: Go tests: tenant B can never be assigned tenant A's profile_ref; a conversation resumes only on its bound node and profile; a lost node marks the conversation broken with no migration. Worker pytest: helper mode derives the dir from profile_ref only.
security-08.risk: Requires a primary-side binding UX for identities (operator-owned).

security-09.title: Manual-login viewer broker: outbound OpenViewer stream, single-use ticket, WS proxy, MFA and RBAC, dashboard wiring
security-09.test_approach: Go tests: ticket replay, expiry, wrong tenant, wrong operator and non-MFA session are denied; the ticket binds node, profile and provider; no helper-supplied URL is ever relayed; the loopback-only sanitizer is unchanged. Dashboard: NAJM design per design.md; vitest asserts non-loopback URLs are still rejected and only ticket paths embed.
security-09.risk: Dashboard CSP is strict; the viewer must be same-origin through the gateway.

security-10.title: Fleet audit wiring and fail-closed append
security-10.test_approach: Go tests: each event name is emitted with the _fleet tenant for node lifecycle and the job tenant for attempt events; a forced audit store error makes grant, enroll and viewer-open refuse; VerifyChain passes after a mixed sequence.
security-10.risk: Chain contention on _fleet under many nodes; auth rejections must be aggregated, not per-attempt.

security-11.title: Node cert tooling and rotation runbook (short-lived, SPIFFE URI SAN, overlap window)
security-11.test_approach: Script emits a node cert with the URI SAN and <=72h validity; integration test rotates current to next with an active stream and no dropped attempt.
security-11.risk: The production CA belongs to the fleet manager; this stays dev-only.

security-12.title: Voice helper control authz: derived TURN creds only, lease-fenced mute/interrupt/terminate
security-12.test_approach: Go tests: the helper spec has no TURNSecret and its creds expire at the session TTL; control RPCs with a stale generation are rejected; cross-tenant session lookup returns the same not-found.
security-12.risk: Blocked on reconciling feat/multimodal-voice-hardening into main (voice files absent on main).

security-13.title: Acceptance isolation suite: cross-tenant, secret-leak, fenced-commit under 1/2/5/10/20 workloads
security-13.test_approach: Multi-tenant load asserts zero cross-tenant events or artifacts, zero duplicate committed results, no secret env in the helper process (env dump scan), and killed or partitioned helpers never produce a stale commit.
security-13.risk: Needs two real or containerized helpers; reuse the existing acceptance harness.
